scope: One sender; SQLite-local simulated effect; no external payment

scenarios.title: A signature is repeatable
scenarios.meaning: The same signed bytes authenticate twice. The stateless verifier does not deduplicate.

scenarios.title: First delivery
scenarios.meaning: The event record and the local simulated effect commit together.

scenarios.title: Replay inside the window
scenarios.meaning: A completed event is recognized. No second local effect is inserted.

scenarios.title: Authentic but stale
scenarios.meaning: The signature was recalculated for the old timestamp. Freshness is the failing control.

scenarios.title: Changed bytes
scenarios.meaning: A changed body with the original signature cannot pass authentication.

scenarios.title: Same identity, new content
scenarios.meaning: Even a valid signature does not authorize reuse of an existing event identity with different content.

scenarios.title: Reopen the database
scenarios.meaning: Duplicate state survives closing and reopening the consumer.

scenarios.title: Sixteen simultaneous deliveries
scenarios.meaning: Independent SQLite connections serialize claims. This is a local concurrency check, not a load benchmark.

scenarios.title: Failure, rollback, retry
scenarios.meaning: An injected exception rolls back the local transaction. A later attempt can complete. External services are outside this transaction.
